block.comment: Straight stages100/150/190/230 accumulate centered time only. Brief F6/F12 trim keeps the current stage, outer wheel at stage PWM and inner minus30, for a shared30ms event. Centered30ms clears that event. Strong side/loss/outer warning resets stages. F10/unexpected patterns stop.
Original 115200-baud raw ADC/F telemetry; no new capture protocol.

Curve base174/gain174/minimum15 after45 percent increase from120/120/10. Straight stages100/150/190/230 retain brief F6/F12 trim without advancing during correction. Strong side or unresolved trim resets stages.
Exclude A1/A5 from center F and weighted position. Their saved raw values now feed the separately confirmed outer sharp-turn assistance.
Read all five ADCs; preserve original raw telemetry.

xml.comment: Start on the narrow line LEFT of the large finish patch, facing away from finish. Three-center-sensor control, sharp corners and short gaps. After departure/minimum run, sustained wide line latches finish stop. This is not measured lap localization. Button waits at boot only.

block.comment: A1=right/A5=left outer assistance. Center-only search gets at most150ms to capture line or receive confirmed outer support; otherwise stop. Outer evidence may correct it once without resetting the800ms total deadline. Confirmed outer plus matching F2/F8 starts before full loss. Outer forward150/inner reverse114; continuous15ms capture finishes at base174.

Short gap PWM45 with fixed120ms deadline. Side-line return starts differential capture20/45 or30/45 immediately. Continuous narrow line15ms finishes; invalid observations reset confirmation, not the event deadline. Wide line returns to marker handling.

Lift: first confirmed wide marker after narrow-line departure, based on user route assumption. Stop without alignment drive; user-requested wait23350ms from stop command, not measured settled feedback. This is below the published27s +/-5% timing. Auto exit PWM45 with1500ms limit. Consume marker once. PWM zero is not active braking. Disable LIFT_ENABLED for the earlier practice mat without a lift.
LED updates only on changes. Green=running; blue=outer-direction probe stop, lift wait, fault or finish. No per-loop NeoPixel show.
